body.message:
As per your request, please find below the 3-month rates for the MAG318 Business Bay 2 Bedroom Apartment:

(1st Month): AED 12,000
(2nd Month): AED 13,500
(3rd Month): AED 15,000

Please note that a security deposit of AED 3,000 is required. The booking will be processed on a monthly basis only, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

Thank you.
